warnings: Cover page. The Thai numeral ๕ in the caption is the house number in the ครอบครัวไทยเป็นสุข series; every other sheet writes it as Arabic 5 (บ้านครอบครัวไทยเป็นสุข 5). Recorded as printed on each sheet rather than normalised.

The perspective confirms three things used when reading the structural sheets: a first-floor balcony over the front porch (the ง''-to-ง' strip on S-01/S-02), a hipped tile roof, and an open carport under the eaves on the east side (the GS slab beyond grid 4).
